一首馬拉卡圖可以從較慢的速度開始，隨著隊伍行進與情緒累積逐漸加快；歌手用領唱呼叫: A maracatu can start at a slower tempo and gradually speed up as the procession moves and the mood builds; the singer pushes the tempo through the density of the lead calls and the drum group's response. Beyond a certain point the ornaments thin out and the drums return to the most basic pattern, because at that speed any extra note breaks the line.
不同納桑代表不同的團體傳統，各有自己的節奏風格、樂器配置、服裝顏色與儀式順序。納: Different nações stand for different group traditions, each with its own rhythmic style, instrument set, costume colours and ritual order. Nações are not versions of one song but independent traditions. In the same city, different nações sound different: some have a heavy, slow bass, others a dense, fast treble.
不同納桑的樂器組合不完全相同，鼓的數量、有沒有某一件響器、歌手站在哪裡，都依團體: The instrument sets of different nações are not identical: the number of drums, whether a given shaker is present, where the singer stands, all vary by group. What is common is the logic of the division: one bass group, one high-frequency group, one lead singer.
不是旁觀者。隊伍的順序、停留、行禮，本身就是節奏的一部分: Not bystanders. The order of the procession, its stops and its salutes are themselves part of the rhythm
伴奏型是循環的，長度固定；領唱呼叫則是刻意跳出循環的樂句，一出現就代表段落要變。: The accompaniment pattern is cyclical with a fixed length; the lead call is a phrase that deliberately steps out of the cycle, and its appearance means a section is about to change. Hearing the call, the drummers know to drop the ornaments and return to the basic pattern, or to move into another section after the answer phrase. This design lets the whole street-length procession — including those at the back who cannot see the singer at all — know by ear where they are.
低音的核心。以木棒（baqueta）擊打鼓面，有些團體用兩根、有些用一根配手掌，: The core of the bass. The head is struck with a wooden stick (baqueta); some groups use two, some one stick and a palm, and now and then a stick on the rim for a different timbre. It plays the rocking pulse

Maracatu is built on the bass of the alfaia and on the lead call; samba is built on the three-layer division of the surdo and on the organisation of the samba school. Treating it as "another kind of samba" means missing its actual structure.

和森巴打擊樂隊相比，差別在誰控制段落與規模。巴特利亞有總監，用雷皮尼克與哨子對數: Compared with the samba bateria, the difference is who controls the sections and the scale. The bateria has a director who orders a corps of dozens with a repinique and a whistle, and its patterns follow the samba school's theme song; maracatu is set going by the singer's lead call, the voice first and the drums after, and the order of the procession and the royal figures also take part in organising the time. One relies on a whistle, the other on the voice.
和薩爾薩康渾托相比，差別在演出型態與時間的依據。薩爾薩是定點編制，有鋼琴、低音、: Compared with the salsa conjunto, the difference is the format and the basis of time. Salsa is a fixed line-up with piano, bass, brass, congas and timbales, all parts sharing a two-bar clave cycle, and the brass passages are written out; maracatu is a procession, the drummers walk with the drums strapped on, time is carried by the lead call and by reference forwards and backwards, and different nações in the same city have their own rhythmic styles and drum patterns.
和西非鼓樂隊相比，差別在低音的角色與循環的來源。曼德鼓隊的敦敦鼓打出一個有名字的: Compared with a West African drum ensemble, the difference is the role of the bass and where the cycle comes from. In a Mande drum ensemble the dundun plays a named cycle and the lead djembe signals over it; in maracatu the alfaia plays only a rocking pulse, the bells of the gonguê and abê fill the gaps, and the sections are decided by the singer's call, not by a lead drum.
唱主句、發出領唱呼叫。整支隊伍的時間與段落由他啟動: Sings the main line and gives the lead call. The time and sections of the whole procession start with him
回應歌手的領唱呼叫。答句結束後鼓群回到循環，加花在循環內進行: Answers the singer's lead call. After the answer phrase the drums return to the cycle, and ornaments stay inside it
它是一種呼叫與回應：歌手唱出一句簡短的呼叫，鼓群與全隊用一個固定的答句回應。呼叫: It is a call and response: the singer sings a short call, and the drum group and the whole procession answer with a fixed phrase. The melody and words of the call can change each time; the answer stays relatively fixed. Every change of section in a maracatu — starting, speeding up, pausing, going into the next song — is set off by the lead call.

找遊行的影片而不是錄音室版本。馬拉卡圖的空間感、隊伍的長度、聲音的前後延遲，都是: Look for videos of processions rather than studio recordings. The sense of space, the length of the procession and the delay between front and back are all part of maracatu.
把岡加的鈴聲拉出來聽。它是連續的，像一條不會斷的線，把整條街縫在一起。: Pick out the gonguê's bell. It is continuous, like a line that never breaks, stitching the whole street together.
提供密集的細碎拍點，填滿低音之間的空隙: Provides dense, fine beats that fill the gaps between the bass
曲目上，馬拉卡圖不是「一首首獨立的鼓曲」，而是一組由歌手帶領的歌。每首歌有自己的: In repertoire, maracatu is not a set of separate drum pieces but a body of songs led by a singer. Each song has its own words, melody and matching drum pattern; the nações' repertory is mostly handed down, with the core songs fairly fixed; some groups add new songs, but not a rewrite around a theme each year, and the core patterns and the mechanism of the lead call do not change. Different nações handle the same song differently: the drum pattern, the placing of ornaments and the way the tempo is pushed are all part of a group's style.
最主要的場合是累西腓與奧林達（Olinda）的狂歡節。納桑在固定的路線上行進，沿: The main occasion is carnival in Recife and Olinda. The nações follow fixed routes, stopping at set points along the way to salute and perform. Beyond carnival they appear at religious festivals, cultural events and the groups' own annual rituals; some nações have long-standing links with Afro-Brazilian religious traditions.
比較不同納桑的錄音。同樣的編制，低音與高音的比重不同，走起來的感覺就完全不同。: Compare recordings of different nações. With the same line-up, a different balance of bass and treble makes the walk feel completely different.
王室角色（rei、rainha）、舞者、旗手: Royal figures (rei, rainha), dancers, standard bearers
納桑是各自獨立的團體傳統，節奏風格、樂器配置、儀式順序與曲目都不同。服裝顏色是辨: The nações are independent group traditions, differing in rhythmic style, instrument set, ritual order and repertory. Costume colour is one clue to telling them apart, but the real difference is in the sound.
納桑（nação）是理解馬拉卡圖的關鍵分類。: The nação is the key category for understanding maracatu.
訊號與伴奏的差別，在於「誰能改變長度」。: The difference between a signal and an accompaniment is which one can change its length.
速度的推進，是整場遊行最明顯的變化。: The push of tempo is the most obvious change over a whole procession.
遊行的同步，靠的是「前後參照」。: The procession stays together by referring forwards and backwards.
阿爾法亞鼓打出的型通常只有幾個音，但每個音的位置都很關鍵：它給出整首歌的搖擺感。: The pattern the alfaia plays is usually only a few notes, but where each one falls is critical: it gives the whole song its swing. The bells of the gonguê and abê are continuous, almost never stopping, filling the gaps the alfaia leaves. The snare drums cut the beat finer. Together the three layers make a "sparse — dense — denser" weave: the sparser the bass, the heavier it feels; the denser the treble, the more the procession is pushed along.
隊伍的順序也是節奏的一部分。: The order of the procession is also part of the rhythm.
領唱呼叫只是歌手開場時喊的一句口號。: The lead call is just a slogan the singer shouts at the start.
領唱呼叫是貫穿整場的段落控制機制。每一次速度改變、暫停、換歌，都由它啟動；鼓群、: The lead call is the mechanism that controls sections throughout. Every change of tempo, every pause, every change of song is set off by it; the drums, the dancers and the whole procession rely on it to know where they are.
領唱呼叫是這個編制的核心機制。: The lead call is the core mechanism of this line-up.
領唱呼叫的實際運作方式值得拆開來看。歌曲開場時，歌手會先唱一句無鼓的呼叫，讓全隊: How the lead call actually works is worth taking apart. When a song opens, the singer sings a call with no drums, so that the whole group hears the melody and the words; the drums come in after the last note of the call and catch the time with the answer phrase. That order — voice first, drums after — matters: it gives the drums time to align with the singer's tempo and lets the words be heard clearly before the drums thicken. At a change of section the drum cycle usually does not stop; the singer calls over the continuing drums, and the group adjusts its ornaments and density to the call. After the answer phrase the drums return to the cycle and the singer carries on with the main line until the next lead call.
馬拉卡圖另有鄉村一線（maracatu rural，或稱 baque solto: Maracatu also has a rural strand (maracatu rural, also called baque solto), whose instrument set and rhythmic shape differ from the urban nações and which is usually tied to the farming culture of the sugar-cane areas. The procession line-up discussed here means the nação strand: the groups with royal figures and the alfaia as their bass core.
馬拉卡圖是森巴的一種，只是地區不同。: Maracatu is a kind of samba, just from a different region.
馬拉卡圖的編制不是為舞台設計的，而是為街道設計的。每一件樂器都要能在走動、擁擠、: Maracatu's line-up is designed for the street, not for the stage. Every instrument has to work clearly while walking, in a crowd, amid noise, so the division is rough: bass, middle and treble bands, each handled by a whole group of people.
馬拉卡圖納桑遊行時有一定的行進順序：旗手在前，王室角色、舞者、鼓群各有位置。這個: A maracatu nação has a set marching order: standard bearers in front, then the royal figures, the dancers and the drums, each with its place. The order is not arbitrary; it decides who sees a signal first, who turns first, who stops first. At a fixed point (a church or a judging stand, say) the procession stops to salute or perform, and the music switches from travelling to standing, density and tempo changing with it. The command for the switch still comes from the singer.
馬拉卡圖隊伍很長，鼓手不可能同時看到歌手與前導的旗手。所以同步分成兩層：節拍由鼓: A maracatu procession is long; no drummer can see the singer and the leading standard bearer at once. So synchronisation works in two layers: the beat is kept by the bass and bells inside the drum group, while sections are passed down from the lead call, layer by layer. The drummers at the front get the call first, and those behind hear the change in front of them and follow. This creates a very short delay, but the delay is not an error: it makes the music of the whole street sound like something moving rather than a stationary block.
馬拉卡圖（Maracatu）— 伯南布哥狂歡節的遊行編制，以領唱呼叫串起歌手、鼓: Maracatu — the carnival procession line-up of Pernambuco, with a lead call threading together singer, drum group and dancers. Ensembles and instrumentation by Next Door Sound Weavers.
馬拉卡圖（maracatu）是巴西東北伯南布哥州、特別是累西腓（Recife）一: Maracatu is a carnival procession tradition of Pernambuco in north-eastern Brazil, especially around Recife. A nação ("nation") is one procession: a singer, a group of bass drummers, bell players, dancers, and figures representing royalty. The whole procession organises its time through a call system driven by the lead singer — the singer calls, the group answers, the drums keep the cycle, and the procession walks.
鼓群的分工是「低音給拍、高音給密度」。: The drum group's division is bass for the beat, treble for density.
